main_issue: Who completes Agent D's unfinished pitch section while D is away: A alone taking it over versus splitting it among the team

A-B.evidence: B said 'He said he'll take it. I think we should let him' (turn 16), which supports A's plan, but B never addressed A directly.

A-C.evidence: C proposed splitting (turn 9) and A rejected it (turn 11). C then conceded with 'Fine. But if it's too much... ask for help' (turns 17, 20), and A replied 'I won't' (turn 21).

A-D.evidence: D first agreed splitting made sense (turn 10), then said 'Okay, Agent A. Let's do it' (turn 12) and walked A through the files (turns 29-34).

B-C.evidence: C asked B's opinion and said it's a lot (turn 15). B said let A do it (turn 16). C answered 'Fine' (turn 17), still with a caveat.

B-D.evidence: B backed A taking the work (turn 16); D agreed to the handover (turn 12). They never spoke to each other.

C-D.evidence: D said 'Agent C's right' about splitting (turn 10), then dropped it and agreed to A's one-owner handover (turn 12), while C stayed uneasy.
